announcements.summary: Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on September 25, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 2 : 21, i.e 2 Equity Shares for every 21 Equity Shares held at an Issue Price of  Rs. 750 per share (including a premium of ₹ 748/- (Rupees Seven Hundred and Forty Eight only) per Rights Equity Share)
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about issue of Securities on Rights Basis
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Rights  is 01-Oct-2026.
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Record date for Rights Issue
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 28, 2026, titled "Press Release under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015".
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Fund Raising Committee Meeting approving the Letter of Offer for Rights Issue
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of 43rd Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026

Natco Pharma Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  43rd Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
Natco Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
